o.text:
Etymology tree
Arabic حَصَلَ (ḥaṣala)
Arabic مَحْصُول (maḥṣūl)bor.
Azerbaijani məhsul
Borrowed from Arabic مَحْصُول (maḥṣūl).
Inherited from Proto-Turkic *ordu, from Proto-Turkic *or- (“army, place of staying of the army, ruler etc.”), whence also English horde.
From Persian چاپ or from Proto-Turkic *čap-.
From Ottoman Turkish چاپ, from Armenian չափ (čʻapʻ).
Morphologically səkkiz + -inci. Cognate with Kazakh сегізінші (segizinši), Turkish sekizinci, Turkmen sekizinji.
From Russian ме́неджмент (ménedžment), from English management.
